resources.name: TIP4P water model parameters

access.notes: Parameters published in Jorgensen, W. L. J. Chem. Phys. 1982, 77, 4156. Point charges, geometry, and Lennard-Jones parameters are standard and publicly documented.

resources.notes: The agent must use the rigid four-site TIP4P model (oxygen LJ, Coulomb point charges on H and an off-oxygen negative charge).

resources.name: Graphite lattice and dielectric parameters

access.notes: In-plane C–C distance a0=1.42 Å, interlayer spacing d=3.35 Å, perpendicular relative permittivity ε⊥=5.75, resulting perpendicular polarizability density α⊥=0.220 Å. These are textbook/public values.

resources.notes: Required for Steele summation and image-dipole polarization terms.
